brief.goal: Bridge new-account Qiankun readonly discovery into Case creation and persist a ready monitor_bootstrap Plan during the first workbench readonly run.
database_write_scope: new account identity and redacted preflight evidence
runtime Case/Job/readonly monitor facts and monitor_bootstrap Plan

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest, Solution Design, project state, and stable mechanism docs
new-account bootstrap orchestration and guarded account lookup
first workbench dry-run monitor readonly and Plan persistence bridge
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, confirmations, monitor creates, resource creates, project creates, and retries
new database schema, endpoint, Plan/action type, or write authorization path
cross-scope advertiser overwrite or raw credential/request/response persistence
validation_plan: workflow-case, workbench conversation/runtime policy, monitor, execution-plan, API, and schema regression
stop_conditions: any unconfirmed real platform write would be required
account identity is not an exact Qiankun match
the bridge weakens current Plan-bound confirmation or fresh-readonly guarantees
